# Pearlcon Rail Services Ltd — Global Railway Procurement & Supply

> UK-based specialist railway supply, sourcing, procurement, logistics, and consultancy company serving global rail operators across the UK, US, Europe, and Middle East.

## About Pearlcon Rail
Established in 2009 in Essex, United Kingdom, Pearlcon Rail Services Ltd delivers complete railway procurement solutions, component sourcing, and supply-chain logistics. We operate dual hubs in Loughton, UK and Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

## Core Capabilities
- **Railway Procurement**: Single purchase order & unified invoicing desk for international rail projects.
- **Component Sourcing**: Track materials, rolling stock components, signaling equipment, overhead line equipment (OLE), and maintenance spares.
- **Compliance & Quality**: Full EN 10204 3.1/3.2 certification, TSI alignment, and Network Rail standards adherence.
- **Global Network**: Network of 5,000+ audited railway equipment manufacturers and suppliers.
